BACKGROUND:

RATIONALE:

• Policy last reviewed September 2025
• Last revised September 2024
• Due for annual review

impact current procedure

policies and is not included in the VSBA model
• Attorney reviewed and approved revisions

TOPIC:
Approve Updated 2026-2027 Textbook Selection and Adoption Proposal
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
IIAA, Textbook Selection and Adoption
IIAA-R, Textbook Selection and Adoption Regulation
BACKGROUND:
This supports the key priority of the division’s strategic plan Elevate '28 and provides WJCC teachers and
students access to current, aligned textbooks and textbook materials. The board previously approved an
adoption process and timeline that included CTE and Mathematics. World Languages has been added as an
additional content area for adoption.
PROPOSED COURSES FOR TEXTBOOK SELECTION & ADOPTION
Course
Timeline
CTE: AP Business & Personal Finance
September – December 2026
Mathematics: Pre-Algebra 6, Pre-Algebra 7,
September – December 2026
Pre-Algebra 8 and Algebra I
*World Languages: Spanish I, II, III, IV and AP
January – April 2027
German I, II, III, IV and AP
Process
The Teaching & Learning and College, Career and Readiness (CCR) departments will lead the textbook
selection and adoption process for each content area in collaboration with review committees and informed by
stakeholder input. The proposal includes the identification of the textbook evaluation committee, a timeline for
the scope of work, and adherence to the guidelines and criteria outlined in Policy IIAA and Regulation IIAA-R,
for each course.
Committee
Each textbook selection committee will include a school board member, division staff, school administrators,
general education teachers, specialists representing content, special education, multilingual learners, gifted,
parents/guardians, and community members.
RATIONALE:
School Board Policy IIAA requires the local school board approve the textbook selection and adoption
schedule, the textbook evaluation committee, and evaluation criteria.

items.title: Approval of Amendment to the Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar
items.body:
MEETING DATE:
11/17/2026
TOPIC:
Approve Amendment to the Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar Related to Capital Improvement Plan
Development
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
DB, Annual Budget
BACKGROUND:
The state code requires that the school board present a balanced budget, in which revenues equal
expenditures, to the city and county on or before April 1st. The FY28 budget year covers the period from July
1, 2027 through June 30, 2028.
The three primary phases in the budget development process include: 1) Superintendent's Proposed Budget
(administrative recommendation presented to the school board); 2) School Board Proposed Budget (school
board recommendation to the James City County Board of Supervisors and the Williamsburg City Council);
and, 3) School Board Adopted Budget (school board adopted budget based upon funding
authorization/appropriation by the county and city).
The process includes three opportunities to gather community input, one in November to discuss the Capital
Improvement Plan (CIP), one in January prior to the development of the Superintendent's Proposed Operating
Budget and another in February prior to approval of the School Board Proposed Operating Budget.
Williamsburg-James City County Public Schools' personnel will develop the CIP in September and October.
The operating budget development process starts with reviewing departmental and school budget requests
beginning in November using the WJCCPS Strategic Plan to provide direction.
The Superintendent's Proposed Budget is developed and presented to the school board in February. After a
public hearing on the budget, the school board approves the School Board Proposed Budget in March and
refers it to the James City County Board of Supervisors and the Williamsburg City Council for consideration.
The localities must approve the appropriation for the school system no later than May 15th or within 30 days of
the receipt by the county or municipality of the estimates of state funds, whichever occurs later. Based upon
approved funding by the county and city, the school board makes any necessary adjustments and approves an
Adopted Budget in May.
RATIONALE:
The School Board approved the Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar on August 18, 2026. Since that approval,
attendance zone modifications associated with the division's redistricting process were finalized on October 20,
2026. The revised attendance zones affect enrollment projections, capacity analyses, and long-term facility
planning assumptions that are used in development of the Capital Improvement Plan (CIP).
In consultation with James City County and the City of Williamsburg, administration recommends adjusting the
FY28 budget calendar to allow sufficient time to incorporate the finalized attendance zones into enrollment



forecasts and CIP recommendations. These revisions will ensure that the proposed CIP reflects the most
current student enrollment and facility planning information prior to School Board consideration.
The following revisions are recommended:
•
•
•
•

Presentation of Superintendent's Proposed Capital Improvement Plan from November 10, 2026 to
January 5, 2027.
Public Hearing on recommended Capital Improvement Plan from November 17, 2026 to January 19,
2027.
Joint Meeting on Capital Improvement Plan and Enrollment from December 4, 2026 to February 5,
2027.
Adoption of the School Board Capital Improvement Plan from December 8, 2026 to February 2, 2027.

The amended FY28 Budget Calendar is included for review.
SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCE(S):
Attendance zone modifications associated with the division's redistricting process were finalized on October
20, 2026. Additional time is needed to incorporate the revised attendance zones into enrollment projections
and facility planning analyses that support development of the Capital Improvement Plan. The proposed
amendment does not affect the operating budget development schedule or statutory budget submission
deadlines.
COST BUDGETED:
As presented in budget documents.
ALTERNATIVES:
1. Approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
2. Do not approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
SUPERINTENDENT’S RECOMMENDATION:
The superintendent recommends the board approve the amendment to the Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar
as presented.
DATA SOURCE:
Daniel Keever, Ph.D., Superintendent
Rene Ewing, Chief Financial Officer
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
Move to approve the amendment to the Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar as presented.
